es: Pon la bola de helado de piña en un vaso grande.
Completa con vino pipeño y termina con la granadina.
en: Put the scoop of pineapple ice cream in a large glass.
Top with pipeño wine and finish with the grenadine.

history.es: Bebida chilena de vino pipeño y helado de piña. Su nombre, "terremoto", alude a los temblores que se dice que deja en quien lo bebe.
history.en: A Chilean drink of pipeño wine and pineapple ice cream. Its name, "earthquake", alludes to the tremors it is said to leave in whoever drinks it.
